reviews.text: Great service.
Hi Adam - We’ve been wagging our tails ever since we saw your review! Thank you fur the review!

we always receive Great care at Banfield. They are very aware of making sure you know how much any procedure, checkup or Medication is going to cost So there are no surprises at the end of the visit. they are incredibly sweet to my dog and always try to get us in as quickly as possible  After the appointments, the vet does a fantastic job explaining what happened during the visit and if any further care is needed
Hi Marisela - We're grateful for your review of our pet hospital! Your positive experience motivates us to do even better.

My pup became sick and was misdiagnosed by the vets there.  They claimed he had leptospirosis and was referred to a specialist. The new specialist discovered the lepto test was never even completed and he was incorrectly perscribed treatment as they "guessed" without proper testing.  We lost a week of treatment as my dog became more ill and passed 9 days later.  After this complete BS service by Banfield i called to cancel his Pet Insurance as he was gone.  I was informed his "insurance" is actually not that- it's a pre-paid medical expenses which in totality is a complete joke. I have to pre pay for expense my dog may or may not use?? This is MY FAULT for not reading through more comprehensively but to charge a monthly rate for a deceased pet that was more a family member is some absolute garbage business and worse human behavior.  I get reminded they misdiagnosed my dog each month via a lovely automatic payment.  DO NOT take your pets here.  Complete lack of professional work and even worse people to keep charging for a deceased pet.  Dumpster juice company.

I had a very disappointing experience at the Bandfield Pet Hoapital on Forest Lane in Dallas. I had a pre-scheduled appointment for my dog’s dental cleaning and expected the visit to go smoothly.

I waited about 30 minutes before being seen. When I was finally helped by a staff member named Alex, I found her to be rude and impatient. I asked several questions about my dog’s procedure and care, and instead of answering them professionally, she seemed frustrated that I was asking questions.

After our conversation, Alex told me they would not be providing my dog’s dental cleaning, even though I have the monthly wellness plan. She initially mentioned that they did not have a record of my dog’s rabies vaccination. However, the impression I was left with was that the appointment was being canceled because she no longer wanted to take my pet as a patient, not simply because of the vaccination record.

If there was an issue with my dog’s records, it should have been identified and communicated before my scheduled appointment. Instead, I spent my time coming in for an appointment that was ultimately refused after an unpleasant interaction.

I left feeling disrespected and disappointed by the lack of professionalism and communication. I hope the clinic improves the way it treats clients and handles these situations in the future.

Staff is super friendly and helped our dog with his ear infection. They were thankfully able to fit him in with a same day drop off appointment! The vet called with an update and reviewed treatment options with me, while not making me feel pressured. She was very kind and definitely made me feel like he was very well taken care of while at Banfield. I normally take him to our original Banfield off Coit in Richardson. However, since we live close by, it is nice to know this is a great location option too! :) Will definitely be back.

I just had the most frustrating experience at this Banfield location. My appointment was at 12 and they asked me to come in at 11:45, which I did. I had booked an in-room appointment and then finally at 12:20 I went to asked when I would be seen since I had been waiting 35 min. The front desk then told me she forgot about me essentially and I got helped right away. When I got helped they tried to take my dog for a drop off appointment and I reminded them I did not book a drop off appointment. They tried to tell me I was mistaken, but I had text messages from your staff confirming it was an in-room appointment. The vet was apparently in surgery and no one could give my dog a vaccine. I have a been on the pet plus plan for YEARS for both of my dogs and this type of service is truly unacceptable. I will be cancelling my 2 plans for my pets unless I am contacted with some sort of resolution.

We signed up Kai for the puppy plan since he was 3 weeks old.  He is now a year old and they are telling us that we "should have" done the WISDOM PANEL (DNA test) when he was under 6months old, but they never notified us of this until today.  Now they are charging to have this service done, when it would have been covered 6months ago had they told us.  Very negligent in keeping us aware of what is covered on the plan in a timely manner.
This spot is always nice. They are on time and give up front pricing for normal situations

We are turned away so often from this place that we have just given up on having services done here. We now go to the Addison location which is a 40-minute drive for us, but it's better than being told no constantly for services covered by or plan or things as simple as an anal glands expression.

I wasn’t able to get her name, however the light skinned curly hair woman, 5/24/2026 at 11:30am who works at the receptionist desk is rude and not someone I would have my dog around for care. She did not greet me, but greeted the customers after me. She didn’t look at me one time while speaking but turned around for others. When i asked her to repeat herself, she caught an attitude. I’d change the receptionist if you want customers to bring their animals here.
Hi Cole - Glad we made your experience a good one—thanks for the review! 🧡🐾 …
Kathy - We're so glad you had a great experience! We’ll make sure to pass this on to our Dallas location. Thanks for partnering with us for your pet’s needs. 🐾 …

My dog Kai got on the puppy plan. They’ve forgotten to give me his heart worm medication for quite sometime, even though I take days off from work to bring him in since I am a teacher. Anyways the vet tech called me the next day and said they forgot to give me the mediation again. I had to go out of town for spring break and when I came back I sent my partner today. They refused to give it to him because he wasn’t authorized and did not inform him they can just call me on the phone and it takes 1 minute to authorize him so he got frustrated and left. I will be canceling my services. The techs need better training.

Signed up for the puppy plan for my dog. They forget to prescribe the heart worm medicine. Won’t let my partner pick it up because he wasn’t authorized. Did not inform him it was a quick phone call. I’m gonna cancel their services
They take such sweet care of my little love.

DO NOT TAKE YOUR PETS TO BANFIELD – GREENVILLE LOCATION

My dog was extremely lethargic, breathing shallow, and could barely walk—very unlike him, as he loved going on walks. I brought him in early one morning. After waiting 30 minutes, they took him back and later told me his bloodwork was “normal,” except for a slightly low blood count. The doctor said since they didn’t know his “average” blood count due to his “old age” (he was only 7), it could be normal.

I had to tell the doctor myself that my dog had bloodwork done just three weeks earlier for a dental procedure. Those prior records were not reviewed. When I asked questions, the doctor was dismissive and spoke to me in a condescending manner, repeatedly saying “Like I said…”. I’ve never had issues with Banfield Mesquite, but Greenville was closer—and I will NEVER return.

The doctor said she wouldn’t send anything home because of a “sensitive stomach” and told me to come back in two days for more bloodwork. I was not notified when my dog was ready; I had to call back myself. When I picked him up, he was clearly not acting normal. A vet tech told me the delay was because the doctor felt something was wrong in his stomach but didn’t know what it was. Despite this, no additional testing or emergency referral was made. I was told to just let him rest.

As the day went on, he got worse. Later that afternoon, he walked up to me, stared into my eyes, and collapsed. He was conscious but unable to move. I called Banfield frantic. The doctor said, “I don’t know why they would leave you home alone with this dog.” My dog weighed 80 lbs, and I was alone.

I managed to get him into the car and rushed him to an emergency vet, where we were told he was bleeding internally. Despite blood transfusions and overnight emergency care, our sweet boy did not make it.

Internal bleeding was later diagnosed at the emergency hospital and was not identified during our visit at Banfield. Based on our experience, I would not trust this location with my pet’s care.
Amazing team. From the front desk to the Doctors. Very friendly and super helpful.

Made appt for my spike. my brown tabby.  Has recently been diagnosed with heart worm and urinary stones.

Wanted 2nd opinion on his conditions.  Vet was patient and informative and answered all questions.

Plus, they provide a pharmacy food card for his RX food. Urinary CD.

I am still happy with primary vet but no hesitation on making this my primary vet or urgent care.

There was no pressure for labs, diagnostics. They got my medical records from current vet. No issues.  I will see them in 6 months for follow up.
You have to sign up for the Banfield pet wellness program it will save you money and keep your pet healthy.

Considering how devastating the loss this was the experience was very good. Kind, compassionate and all the time to scream and cry and cry. The best cost. Available through having been a. BanfieldMember for the Care of Babette. The very best Baby Babette!
This location’s vets and staff are great and always helpful and friendly!
We're thrilled that you and your pet had a positive experience with us. Thanks for sharing your review!
Great care for my pets! None better.

I have been bringing my pets to Banfield Pet Hospital at 5500 Greenville Ave for the past 15 years, and I cannot recommend this location highly enough. Over the years, they have cared for three of my beloved companions: the late, great Pedee, Rocco (who first brought me to Banfield as a puppy), and Arges The One-Eyed Wonder.
Before finding Banfield, I tried several vets around Dallas and was never fully satisfied. Too often, other clinics nickel-and-dimed me, sometimes even charging me for services they asked if they could perform “because they enjoyed it,” making it seem like I was doing them a favor by agreeing. By contrast, Banfield is completely transparent. They always let me know upfront what my cost will be and never hesitate to call if any additional services are needed. That honesty and respect have built my trust over the years.
Another reason this location stands out is their compassion and understanding. Unlike other vets I’ve visited, who reprimanded me when I asked to have prescriptions forwarded to more affordable suppliers like 1-800-PetMeds or Chewy, the staff here understood my situation. They know I am a school teacher and not highly paid, and to my pleasant surprise, the first time they offered (without me even asking) to send my prescriptions to a cheaper source I knew they were a keeper. That kind of thoughtfulness and empathy meant the world to me and showed me that they truly care about both pets and the people who love them.
The staff always greets us with genuine warmth and excitement, treating me like family and my dogs like celebrities. They consistently go above and beyond to make sure my boys are healthy, comfortable, and happy.
The quality of care, professionalism, and compassion at this Banfield are unmatched. Whether it’s routine visits, follow-ups, or unexpected needs, I know my pets are in the best possible hands. After 15 years, I can confidently say this team has earned my complete trust and loyalty.
If you’re looking for a veterinary team that will treat your pets as if they were their own, look no further, this Banfield location is the best of the best.
A big thank you for your pawsome review! 🐾 We hope to see you again soon. …

They do a great job every time I come in! My pets have really taken to their team! Thank you Hailey, Maricela, Jessica & Dr Sokolova.

They are quick and I appreciate the suggestion for follow ups to ensure my dogs are fully treated and healed from any issues. The monthly plan is a good option I have had it for a couple years now. Highly recommend!

-Gumi & Juno approved 🫡
Did my cat's vaccines. Had to go in person to get the paperwork after, though. Nice staff.
They care about animals💖🐶🙏 …

The doctors and nurses here at Banfield were very careful with the care of Teddy P. They even cut his prescriptions into parts up for me so I wouldn’t have to. Thank you all for your concern and excellent care for my fur baby. We appreciate all that you do here!
Glad we made your experience a good one—thanks for the review! 🧡🐾 …
I would highly recommend this veterinarian. They are great with my cat.

We got one of their kitten plans hoping they would help us with get a stay cat we we're trying to adopt squared away. One of the biggest mistakes we ever made because we thought they would figure out what she needed before we could introduce her to our house cat. We didn't realize, but they didn't do the parasite fecal test on any of the previous visits we had. However, after just the first visit the doctor said she didn't see any reason why we couldn't introduce her to our house cat. We also asked when we could get her spayed and they mentioned after she gets her boosters. When we got that taken care of, the day of her spaying appointment they told they couldn't do the procedure because she was pregnant, but that she was perfectly fine. Fast forward a few weeks, we found some rice/sesame seed like grains on our cats bed. Turned out she had a tapeworm and had they done the fecal test months ago we wouldn't have infected our other house cat. They tried to rectify their mistakes by having us take our stray cat's poo and our house cat so they can check her for tapeworms. Upon that visit, they checked our house cat for various other things except for the tapeworm and said she was healthy and good to go home. We took her come and surprise! a worm fell out of our cats butt. They kept trying to shift the blame and say it was our fault because we initially denied our stray cat from getting flea preventative but on neither of the visits did they educate us on any risks. They made it our choice to get it. Additionally, they mentioned that we never took a vile to collect her poop so they could check, but again they never mentioned it to us. The manager and nurses kept trying to make excuses for their mistakes and redirected the blame on us by saying that our stray cat didn't have fleas on the first few visits, but they also mentioned that they never checked for them. They couldn't even get their facts straight on which cat they were talking about and we only have 2. The manager mentioned that there was many things she didn't know about until she started working there, but yet she blamed us and supported her staff for our cats having fleas and worms like we're supposed to know everything about cats. This has been a complicate waste of time, money, and effort because not the manager, nurses, or doctors seem to really care about the strain they put us and our cats.

We will be cancelling our plan going to a pet hospital where they actually care and know what they're doing.
I was a walk-in with my pup who had a seizure.  The staff was very kind and accommodating.
If the hospital is gonna be closed just for the parade, at least let the customers know.
You've got us purring with your rating! 😺 Thank you for choosing Banfield. …

I was extremely displeased with the bedside manner of the veterinarian that i worked with. She called to tell me that my dog had bone cancer, the call wasn’t that bad, though i really felt that’s something you should tell someone in person. However when i got there to pick my dog up, she kept repeating over and over that my dog wasn’t going to live long enough to make use of care plan. I was standing there sobbing and she just kept saying it. I did not have nearly $600 to pay the bill outright and it was like she was just rubbing salt in the wound. I would never recommend this vet to anyone. That was such an awful experience. The doctor was very smart, but really needs to work on how she speaks to people in distress.

Not much to say, at least the wait isn’t as bad as the Banfield inside PetSmart. Sometimes the ladies are very nice and sometimes they’re not a very good mood but definitely way better than the other locations.
Woof-tastic! Thank you for the rating for our pet hospital. Your feedback is like treats for us! We're eager to make your pet's next visit just as tail-waggingly amazing.
Ba field is a superb vet. Kind. Knowledgeable. Excellent vets - both diagnostics and treatment. And have also helped with EoL situations. Thank you. Highly recommend 👍🙏 …

Banfield sucks now. Overtly expensive for things other vets do for 50% of the price. The vets don’t even meet with you after your appointment half the time. Setting an appointment is frustrating as the front desk staff are standoffish at times. I would recommend everyone go to CHEW, save money, save time, and save any frustration this company causes. They try to upsell multiple things your pets may not need since a $1,000 appointment means more to them than just making sure your animals are okay.
Your care and attention to my mom and my cats princess and pumpkin great job
Terrible service and care.
Would give this place zero stars if I could 👏🏽 …

Don’t bring your animal here. I brought my cat for a checkup they ran extra tests I didn’t agree too, I ended up having to pay $500 out of pocket. The receptionist told me they couldn’t do the rabies shot I needed and why I went in the first place. Then the vet called and told me they could. They didn’t end up doing the rabies shot and I had to come back the next week. They got a new system and didn’t have any information on my cat. I had to pay for another visit out of pocket, because the receptionist or nurse and vet doctor didn’t communicate.
Then they do the rabies shot, tell me my cat has a heart murmur, which why wasn’t that on the test results from the Saturday before? Then they didn’t write the correct doctors name in the paper told me that my pets rabies file wouldn’t be valid without the signature, I had to go to work. I asked for some type of proof since they had messed up and lost the paperwork from before, they wouldn’t give me any confirmation. Doc never called me once they “fixed” the paper. Horrible service. And I’m upset I spent any money there. Honestly I deserve a visit refund.

_______
11/5
I received a somewhat brash voicemail response to the concerns in this review, which doesn’t make me want to call back the money doesn’t matter as much as the customer service alongside care for my animal. It was explained a heart murmur may not be present due to the purring and I consented to all the testing (although I feel like I was coerced and the person assisting me did not know what was going on fully I wish I knew his name) despite that since I’ve written my original review I still haven’t gotten my paperwork about the rabies shot they gave my pet that shows the proof of purchase of this so I can give it to my pet insurance and file my claim. (Although Jeannie did say she had paperwork in the voicemail so I would love to get that!) Additionally she didn’t mention anything about the lack of paperwork they mentioned to offer me about the rabies shot and why I was hesitant to leave without it in the first place. All she did was harp on opposing and negating. Like I originally stated,  when the doctor spoke to me on the phone at the original appointment she said that since she felt like the stomach issues were due to stress to a flea, she said they could do the rabies shot in the same first appointment so I don’t have to stress my cat out to bring him back again. When I went to pick him up the receptionist looked at me blankly and said “well she didn’t tell me that” and I didn’t think to fight it not knowing I would have to pay for an extra office visit because of their lack of communication. Just disappointed again and again. I’m done with this pet hospital. You don’t need to be rude, unkind repeatedly and by multiple people, when there are other places that will be kinder, and more organized. Just my experience here, I hope others are better!

Took our fur baby here and they took great care of her. I dropped her off in the morning before I went to work and they ran all the tests and the doc took time to call me and explain everything. We joined their wellness plan and they got our pup all up to date on vaccine and check ups! Great experience.
Thank you "fur" the review! 🐕  …
Thanks for the pawsitive review!
